question: Which Union Minister of State addressed the inaugural function of 4th National Young Superintendents of Police Conference and Police Expo in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nityanand Rai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Union Minister of State for Home Affairs, Shri Nityanand Rai addressed the inaugural function of the 4th National Youth Superintendents of Police Conference and Police Expo.**
 
• Bishweswar Tudu is not a Union Minister of State. He is a Member of Parliament from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP
